core_obligations: Collect the flatness and henselization facts that both parts use: smooth maps, localizations, compositions and base changes are flat, flat local maps are faithfully flat, and henselizations are flat (proof lines 31607-31614).

Part (2): replace the rings by their henselizations so that the smaller one is henselian, and use flatness and faithful flatness together with going down to see that a minimal prime of the larger henselization lies over a minimal prime of the smaller ring and every minimal prime of the latter occurs (proof lines 31615-31628).

Reduce to the case where the smaller ring is a domain by dividing out a minimal prime, keeping the henselian property, and use the unibranch statement to see that the integral closure of that domain in its fraction field is a local domain (proof lines 31629-31636).

Use that normality goes up along the henselization of the larger ring, that the tensor product of the integral closure with that henselization is local by the hypothesis on the residue fields, and conclude that it is a local normal ring, hence a domain containing the henselization of the larger ring, which is therefore a domain (proof lines 31637-31657).

Part (1): repeat the same scheme with strict henselizations, so that the count of branches is replaced by the count of minimal primes after a strictly henselian base, and the geometric irreducibility statement plays the role of the unibranch statement (proof lines 31658-31686).
proof_roadmap: Record the flatness and henselization input common to both parts (proof lines 31607-31614).
Part (2): pass to henselizations and reduce to a single minimal prime over a given one (proof lines 31615-31628).
Make the smaller ring a domain and control the henselization of the larger one through the tensor product with the integral closure (proof lines 31629-31657).
Part (1): the same argument with strict henselizations and the geometric irreducibility statement (proof lines 31658-31686).
difficulty_reason: statement 是「光滑局部同态的（几何）分支数不变」两条。证明是两段几乎平行的论证，各自 40 行左右：先集中列出要用的一串平坦性/hensel 化事实（13 处跨章引用几乎都堆在这一段），然后 pass 到 hensel 化、用平坦下降把极小素理想对应起来，约化到 A 是整环，再用「A' 是局部整环」「正规性沿 hensel 化上推」「A'⊗B^h 局部」三条把 B^h 逼成整环；第 (1) 部分把 hensel 化换成严格 hensel 化、把单枝换成几何不可约，结构完全一样。**判 H3 的理由**：16 处引用（3 同章、13 跨章）而且开头一大段就是引用清单式罗列，承重演算虽有（都是「张量积保持局部/正规 + 域性」这类短推断），但整体读起来相当依赖外部事实。仍属完整证明（span 正好 `\begin{proof}`→`\end{proof}`），可收。
